name: Get Sample Screenshots
description: Save the screenshots VMRay took while analysing a sample as files in the playbook run's storage — costs no quota.

sample_id.description: VMRay sample ID — e.g. the `sample_ids` of Get Submission Result or Get Samples By Hash.
sample_id.title: Sample ID

submission_id.description: VMRay submission ID — e.g. the `submission_ids` of Submit Sample. It is resolved to its sample with one GET /submission/{id}. Used when `sample_id` is empty.
submission_id.title: Submission ID

max_screenshots.description: The most screenshots to save, taking the newest analyses first.
max_screenshots.title: Max screenshots

path.description: The screenshot's file in the playbook run's storage.
path.title: Path

name.description: The screenshot's name in the analysis archive.
name.title: Name

found.description: True when at least one screenshot was saved.
found.title: Found

sample_id.description: The sample the data belongs to.
sample_id.title: Sample ID

files.description: The saved screenshots as {"path": ...}, the shape the file actions take.
files.title: Files

screenshots.description: The saved screenshots with their analysis and size.
screenshots.title: Screenshots

errors.description: Screenshots or analyses that could not be read.
errors.title: Errors
